title: Board Sizes: content types and a calmer UI
lede: Pick a piece of content and see every board it needs; share a link with no way back to the site; export sizes, CSV or an After Effects script. Restyled from blueprint to a quiet, document-like app.

changes.h: No way to see what a piece of content needs
changes.was: You had to know which boards to build for.
changes.now: Content types in the sidebar: our four broad types (marked draft) and Colosseum’s 27 game-day pieces, grouped Scoring, Noise, Plays, Living holds, Moments.

changes.h: Sharing sent people into the site
changes.was: A link included the Tools navigation.
changes.now: “Share link” copies a URL with share=1; that view has no link back to the site.
“AE comps” downloads a .jsx that creates one named comp per distinct canvas at the right size, frame rate and duration.

changes.was: Heavy blue grid, outlined display type.
changes.now: System type, hairlines, light/dark, sidebar navigation; drawings kept.
